chains.description: Equipment and factory systems used to execute, control, and support front-end semiconductor wafer manufacturing.
chains.scope: Covers wafer-fabrication process equipment, inspection and metrology, wafer automation, vacuum and process delivery, and fab utility systems.
exclusions: Semiconductor materials are owned by the semiconductor materials chain.
Semiconductor packaging and test equipment are owned by the packaging and test chain, except wafer_thinning is temporarily canonical here and may be referenced by advanced packaging.
